```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<p>visible</p><span style=\"visibility:hidden\">secret hidden span</span><p>also visible</p>");
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
